_comment: Synthetic recall/judge fixture. Seeds a fresh in-memory DB; independent of the live repo. Grow it as retrieval evolves — keep expected_ids referencing existing memory ids.

memories.title: OAuth2 PKCE flow
memories.content: authorization code exchange with PKCE code_verifier and code_challenge for public clients

memories.title: JWT signing key rotation
memories.content: rotate asymmetric signing keys with a kid header and overlapping validity windows

memories.title: HTTP retry with backoff
memories.content: exponential backoff with jitter and a retry budget for idempotent requests

memories.title: Circuit breaker pattern
memories.content: open the circuit after a failure threshold, half-open probe before closing again

memories.title: LRU cache eviction
memories.content: least recently used eviction policy backed by a doubly linked list and a hash map

memories.title: Bloom filter membership
memories.content: probabilistic set membership with false positives but no false negatives using k hash functions

memories.title: Postgres partial index
memories.content: create a partial index with a where clause to shrink index size for selective queries

memories.title: Postgres autovacuum tuning
memories.content: tune autovacuum scale factor and cost delay to reclaim dead tuples on hot tables

memories.title: Idempotency keys for payments
memories.content: store an idempotency key per payment request to make retries safe and avoid double charge

memories.title: Saga distributed transaction
memories.content: coordinate long-lived transactions with compensating actions instead of two phase commit

memories.title: Token bucket rate limiting
memories.content: token bucket refills at a fixed rate and requests consume tokens to smooth bursts

memories.title: gRPC bidirectional streaming
memories.content: bidirectional streaming lets client and server send message sequences over one connection
